notes.subject: הרע תרעו
notes.rationale: root רעע doubled — 'evil ye do evil' — the Hebrew repeats the root; rendered once as noun once as verb

notes.subject: תספו
notes.rationale: ספה: 'swept away' (jps, bsb) vs 'consumed/perish' (kjv, wycliffe); Bambara 'bɛna bɔ yen' keeps removal sense

notes.subject: to Israel
notes.rationale: Samuel addresses the people directly — condition with 'aw' (you plural) throughout

notes.subject: kokura
notes.rationale: 'still/again' supplied for the infinitive absolute הרע emphasis

translation: Nka ni aw kɛna jurumu ye kokura, aw fana ni aw masakɛ fana, aw bɛna bɔ yen.
